4th year = 120 = 144

= 10.8

questions_hin.q_hi: In an office of 900 employees, on a particular day, except for 10% of the female employees, all employees were present. On the next day, except for 8% of the male employees, all employees were present. The number of employees present on each of these two days was the same. Find the total number of male employees on the payrolls of this office.
o_hi:
800

    500

    450    

    550
800
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution
Let total male & female = 100m & 100f
ATQ,
100m + 90f = 92m + 100f
8m = 10f
m : f = 5 : 4
Total = 9x
Total no. of employees =9x→900
x = 100
Male employees =5x=5×100=500
